name: Oleksandr Mirosh
biography: Oleksandr Mirosh is a Security Researcher on the Fortify Software Security Research team at OpenText, where he focuses on investigating emerging threats and developing detection and remediation rules for enterprise software. With over 18 years of experience in computer security, specializing in vulnerability research, reverse engineering, and penetration testing, his work centers on flaws in JNDI, authentication protocols, data serialization, and transformation logic across Java and .NET ecosystems. His research has led to the discovery of numerous CVEs in widely deployed enterprise applications and framework libraries. A frequent speaker at Black Hat USA and DEF CON, he has also presented at other security conferences like OWASP Global AppSec and BSidesLV.
